basics.name: Fanny Bagus Ramadhan
basics.label: Software Developer & IT Engineer
basics.summary: Software developer with 5+ years of experience in web systems, server infrastructure, and hosting solutions. Comfortable working full-stack from frontend (React, Vue.js) to backend (Laravel, Node.js, Go) and infrastructure management (Proxmox, Docker, Linux). Hands-on experience in real production environments including a hospital information system (SIMRS), hosting platform management, and large-scale server monitoring.

Built an omnichannel chat system integrated with Telegram and WhatsApp for customer service to support company-client communication needs
